information_requirement_traceability.description: The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.

business_requirements.name: BR-01: Authorize Delivery Partner Pickup
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must authorize the Delivery Partner to initiate pickup of an order only after the Handover Confirmation record is generated and validated, ensuring that physical goods match the digital order before transport begins.
business_requirements.business_objective: To prevent mismatched deliveries and ensure the logistics leg is only triggered when the order is physically ready and verified.
business_requirements.business_value: Reduces delivery errors, prevents customer dissatisfaction from receiving wrong items, and ensures accurate billing by confirming goods are ready for transport.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states that the confirmation 'verifies that the physical goods match the digital order, preventing mismatched deliveries' and acts upon the Delivery Partner to initiate pickup.

origin.description: The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders where pickup is authorized only after valid Handover Confirmation

policies_and_constraints: Handover must occur before the delivery agent can pick up the order.
Confirmation must indicate all items have been picked and verified.
assumptions: The system can validate the Handover Confirmation record against the digital order details.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Pickup initiated without confirmation leads to empty or mismatched deliveries.
Dependency: Relies on accurate timestamping and item integrity checks.

business_requirements.name: BR-02: Validate Order Integrity and Condition
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must record and validate the condition status and quality check notes of an order at the point of handover to ensure item integrity and identify discrepancies before transport.
business_requirements.business_objective: To maintain product quality standards and enable immediate flagging of orders with missing items or packaging issues.
business_requirements.business_value: Protects brand reputation by ensuring customers receive undamaged goods and allows for early intervention on quality issues.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR requires recording 'Condition Status' and 'Quality Check Notes' and supports the business decision to 'Flag orders for quality review if discrepancies are found during pickup.'

origin.description: The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders with recorded condition status and quality notes

policies_and_constraints: Packaging must be complete before the handover status can be set.
Validation must match the completion of all picking steps.
assumptions: Store staff are trained to accurately assess item condition.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Undocumented damage leads to customer disputes later.
Dependency: Relies on the accuracy of the Fulfillment Supervisor's assessment.

business_requirements.name: BR-03: Establish Delivery Timeline Clock
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must initiate the delivery timeline clock upon the generation of the Handover Confirmation record, using the Handover Timestamp as the start point for service level calculations.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure accurate tracking of delivery performance and compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
business_requirements.business_value: Enables accurate performance measurement, ensures SLA compliance, and provides transparency to customers regarding delivery windows.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states that the confirmation 'initiates the clock for the final delivery timeline' and requires a 'Handover Timestamp' to establish the start of delivery.

origin.description: The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.

success_measures.measure: Accuracy of delivery timeline clock initiation relative to handover timestamp
Percentage of orders meeting SLA delivery windows

policies_and_constraints: Timestamps must be accurate and verifiable by the delivery system.
Handover must be authorized by the store's fulfillment supervisor.
assumptions: The system has a synchronized time source for accurate timestamping.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inaccurate timestamps lead to SLA disputes.
Dependency: Relies on the integrity of the Handover Timestamp data.

business_requirements.name: BR-04: Update Order Lifecycle Status
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must automatically transition the Order Status from 'Pending Preparation' to 'Ready for Pickup' upon successful validation of the Handover Confirmation record.
business_requirements.business_objective: To maintain accurate order visibility and ensure downstream systems (e.g., Delivery Partner apps) reflect the correct state of the order.
business_requirements.business_value: Improves operational efficiency by preventing duplicate work and ensures the correct workflow stage is active for all stakeholders.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR requires an 'Order Status Update: Transition from 'Pending Preparation' to 'Ready for Pickup'' and states the record is 'Acted upon by the Delivery Partner to initiate pickup.'

origin.description: The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders with correct status transition upon handover

policies_and_constraints: Confirmation records must be linked to the specific order ID.
Unfulfilled tasks must trigger alerts or reassignment notifications.
assumptions: The system can automatically trigger status updates based on record validation.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Stale status information leads to operational delays.
Dependency: Relies on the accuracy of the Handover Confirmation record.

business_requirements.name: BR-05: Alert on Unfulfilled Tasks
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system must trigger alerts or reassignment notifications when the Handover Confirmation record indicates that tasks (e.g., picking, packing) remain unfulfilled or discrepancies are found.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure operational continuity and prevent delays caused by incomplete order preparation.
business_requirements.business_value: Reduces order abandonment, minimizes delays in the logistics chain, and ensures timely resolution of fulfillment issues.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR mentions 'Unfulfilled tasks must trigger alerts or reassignment notifications' as a functional rule, implying a need for a control mechanism to handle exceptions.

origin.description: The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.

success_measures.measure: Reduction in time-to-resolution for unfulfilled tasks
Percentage of unfulfilled tasks resolved before handover

policies_and_constraints: Alerts must be triggered immediately upon detection of unfulfilled tasks.
assumptions: The system can detect discrepancies between the digital order and physical handover.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Failure to alert leads to delayed deliveries.
Dependency: Relies on the system's ability to validate task completion.
